title: Restricted-material flag
description: Access marking as printed and the eligibility decision. The authoritative list of restricted items is config/restricted_material.json (RM register); this flag records what the producer observed. The validator independently checks every record against the register, so a missing or false flag cannot let a registered item through.

access_marking.description: Marking exactly as printed, e.g. a protective marking on page 1; null if none observed.

eligibility.description: ELIGIBLE_ALL_USERS: may be shown to the whole admitted audience. NOT_ASSESSED: blocks publication. RESTRICTED: never bundled, indexed, embedded or sent anywhere.

restriction_id.description: Register id (RM-nnn) when eligibility is RESTRICTED.
